task: Phase 2 task 013: wire BracketedEtaTracker into a live event

app/orchestration/progress/service.py.summary: Wires the already-built, already-unit-tested BracketedEtaTracker (eta.py, W-PAR task 007) into ProgressService: a per-job tracker (_bracket_trackers) is fed real segment completions at the existing SEGMENT_SAVED transition inside publish() (pool key = engine_id, chars_completed = active_render_group_weight, wall_seconds computed from a per-segment start-time stamp taken at first observation in enrich(), _segment_start_wall). Pool concurrency caps are resolved via a new module-level _resolve_pool_cap() helper (mirrors the manifest-max + resolve_effective_cap admission logic in cap_settings.py/synthesis.py, cached per job in _bracket_pool_caps, resolved OUTSIDE the leaf lock per D7 since it reads live settings). The chapters.progress event builder call now computes tracker.bracket(remaining_chars=...) (only once a tracker exists and status is non-terminal) and passes eta_low_seconds/eta_high_seconds/eta_display through to build_chapter_progress_event. Added engine_id param to publish()/_build_progress_payload (previously never threaded end-to-end -- a pre-existing gap this task closes as a prerequisite, since without it the tracker's pool key always fell back to a single 'default' pool). Cleanup of _bracket_trackers/_bracket_pool_caps/_segment_start_wall added to both existing per-job eviction branches (queued reset, terminal).

app/orchestration/scheduler/orchestrator.summary: Threads the already-locally-resolved engine_id (previously computed only for has_segment_support lookup) through to progress_service.publish(engine_id=...), so ProgressService's per-job BracketedEtaTracker pool key reflects the real active engine instead of always defaulting to 'default'. Fixed engine_id from being conditionally-unbound (was only assigned inside 'if context.payload:').

app/api/contracts/events.py.summary: build_chapter_progress_event gained additive eta_low_seconds/eta_high_seconds/eta_display params (snake_case, same additive convention as active_segments_map); only written into the payload when eta_display is not None, so the fields are entirely absent (not null placeholders) until a job's BracketedEtaTracker exists.

tests/orchestration/test_bracketed_eta_w.summary: New TDD wiring test (R1 revert-checked: fails red with the pre-fix code, per the task's own instruction that BracketedEtaTracker was pure dead code before this task). Drives sequential segment completions through ProgressService.publish() and asserts: (1) no bracket fields at all before any segment completes, (2) 'estimating…' with null bounds before the 3rd completion (no-fabrication guard, wire-level), (3) a numeric bracket appears after the 3rd completion, (4) the existing eta_seconds/etaSeconds field is unaffected by the new bracket fields (cap=1 parity).
